title: VLAN Trunking Protocol (VTP)
description: Understand VTP modes and configure VTP on the switch.
scenario: Understand VTP modes and configure VTP on the switch.

concepts.title: What is VTP?
concepts.body: VTP (VLAN Trunking Protocol) propagates VLAN information across trunk links. Modes: Server, Client, Transparent.
concepts.code:
Server: creates VLANs, propagates
Client: receives VLANs
Transparent: local only, forwards

concepts.title: VTP Modes
concepts.body: Server stores and advertises VLANs. Client only learns. Transparent keeps VLANs local and forwards advertisements.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# vtp mode transparent
SW1(config)# vtp domain CCNA

concepts.title: Verifying VTP
concepts.body: "show vtp status" shows VTP version, domain, mode, and revision number.
concepts.code:
SW1# show vtp status
VTP Version: 2
Domain Name: CCNA
VTP Mode: Transparent
